name: game.reachStory
description: Decides a step of a story reached, or where the player is in it, saved so they come back there.

spec.title: Save my place in the story
spec.description: Saves the sender's place in a story: the target is the story's starting area (the farmstead of the first hour), step the step just reached (empty to save only where they are), area the area they are in and x, z where they stand in it. game.story gives it back, so Play the first hour resumes there. item and spot record a herb gathered (S7); use spends one cooking and body saves the Hum, Chill and Hunger (S8); clock saves the story's day and hour (S9); told records what the player told Wenlan after his reading (S10), and the ditch step pays one silver; foretold is the conclusion drawn in the notes (S13); watch is the foretold night begun and defended the farmhouse held until dawn (S14); thanked is Wenlan's thanks the morning after, which gives items.knot (S15); dream is the dream at the ford in a blessed place, which gives items.wound until a warm night spends it with use: wound (S16); companion is the first companion joined, a veteran of the Drum (S17). Refused for an unknown step or item, or an area that does not exist. well is the well in the yard, where the Hollowed come up now both hearths are warded, which gives items.welllore (S26). wellward is the well warded with a sage and the river stones, which gives items.wellward (S27). track is the frost track from the warded well to the signpost (S28). ashby is the remnants of the raid on Ashby, reached in the area the signpost leads to, which gives items.ashbylore (S29). S30: told is word of Ashby given to Wenlan. S31: council is the hearth-watch meeting at Hawk's Rest.

step.description: The step just reached: arrive, farmer, howl, signature, trail, fight, road, rest, morning, forage, herbal, stillness, cook, almanac, sleep, reading, ditch, foretold, watch, defended, thanked, dream, companion, stones, cache, bundles, truedream or ward; empty to save only the place

item.description: S7: a herb just gathered (thyme, nettle or yarrow; S20: lavender, mugwort, valerian or sage from the bundles; S22: riverstones from the culvert), with spot; empty for none

spot.description: S7: where the item was gathered, so each spot gives it once

use.description: S8: a herb spent, cooking at a hearth (thyme, nettle, yarrow, valerian, sage, mugwort or lavender); empty for none. Refused unless the player holds one

body.description: S8: the character's Hum, Chill and Hunger as they are now: {hum (0 to the sky's pool), chill (0 to 100), hunger (0 to 100)}; left out, the saved body stays

clock.description: S9: the story's clock as it is now: {day (days since the night of the first snow), hour (0 to 24)}; left out, the saved clock stays

day.description: Days since the night of the first snow

hour.description: The hour of the day, 0 to 24

told.description: S10: what the player told Wenlan after his three-card reading: all (the ditch and the warning in the last card) or ditch (only the ditch); empty for nothing new

area.description: The id of the area the player is in

x.description: Where they stand in that area, metres east of its corner

z.description: Where they stand, metres south of its corner

outputs.description: The step just reached, or empty
The character's Hum, Chill and Hunger, or nothing
The story's day and hour, or nothing
What the player told Wenlan, or empty
The area the player is in
Metres east of the area's corner
Metres south of the area's corner

config.expr: !started || start?.deleted == true ? "there is no area " + target + " to start a story in" : (step ?? "") not in ["", "arrive", "farmer", "howl", "signature", "trail", "fight", "road", "rest", "morning", "forage", "herbal", "stillness", "cook", "almanac", "sleep", "reading", "ditch", "foretold", "watch", "defended", "thanked", "dream", "companion", "stones", "cache", "bundles", "truedream", "ward", "tried", "hearthward", "farmward", "well", "wellward", "track", "ashby", "told", "council", "northroad", "reeve", "aldermere", "steward", "waited", "kingscouncil"] ? "there is no step " + step + " in the story" : (item ?? "") not in ["", "thyme", "nettle", "yarrow", "lavender", "mugwort", "valerian", "sage", "riverstones"] ? "there is no herb " + item + " to gather" : (told ?? "") not in ["", "all", "ditch"] ? "told must be all or ditch" : (use ?? "") != "" && ((place?.items ?? {})[use] ?? 0) < 1 ? "you have no " + use + " to use" : !found || here?.deleted == true ? "there is no area " + area : x < 0 || z < 0 || x > here.width * 10 + 1 || z > here.depth * 10 + 1 ? "the point is outside " + here.name : ""

{step: step ?? "", item: item ?? "", spot: spot ?? "", use: use ?? "", told: told ?? "", area: area, x: round(x * 100) / 100, z: round(z * 100) / 100, body: body == nil ? nil : {hum: max(0, min(10, round(body.hum ?? 0))), chill: max(0, min(100, round(body.chill ?? 0))), hunger: max(0, min(100, round(body.hunger ?? 0)))}, clock: clock == nil ? nil : {day: max(0, int(clock.day ?? 0)), hour: max(0, min(23.9, round((clock.hour ?? 0) * 10) / 10))}}

config.fix: send a step of the first hour and a point in an existing area
